our approved item from the same advice-by-radio set (the numbered medical chest): match its outline weight, shading and finish only; do not copy its shape

prompt:
GAME ITEM SPRITE. One single object seen from above at a slight angle, centred, like an item lying on the ground in a top-down strategy game.

Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for a field slow-scan television kit, used to send a still picture by radio. Images 1 and 2 are our approved items from the same game: match their outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy their shapes.

Draw ONLY the object, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 75 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

An open rugged dark grey hard case with foam inserts holding: a small boxy camera with a short lens, a compact scan converter box with a few small knobs and one small green indicator light, a small square monochrome monitor showing a faint grey picture, and a coiled black cable with a plug.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, muted dark grey, black and steel colours with the small green light, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, people, animals or ground. No shadow outside the object.
